facts.fact: ESCOM (Electricity Supply Corporation of Malawi), in its own 7 Oct 2025 slides, describes an operating ESCOM data centre in Blantyre offering cloud computing, physical hosting (rack space and bare-metal servers) and virtualization to customers, open to government and private clients; 2 modules of 21 racks, 595TB storage, 99.98% uptime. No opening date is given, so as_of is the document's publication date.
